confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sanya's resort pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak domestic summer season and rates vary widely by district and hotel tier. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor using an assumed local bar-to-draft ratio (about 5x for cocktails and 4.5x for wine), because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX figure is taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on China's southern resort cities such as Haikou and Hainan coastal towns, adjusted for Sanya's higher summer tourism demand, and cross-checked loosely against Southeast Asian beach resorts such as Da Nang and Phuket for the tourist-facing price tiers.
